title.narrative: General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - Human Resources

description.narrative: Strengthen knowledge: provide information and educational resources in various fields that contribute to developing individuals' skills. Develop skills: provide specialized training programs in human resources fields, such as recruitment, performance management, and training and development. Empower individuals: equip participants with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed in their careers.

The General Volunteer Project for Knowledge Enrichment and Transfer - Human Resources is an initiative aimed at improving human resources through enhancing knowledge, training and professional development. The project focuses on providing individuals with the skills needed to succeed in the work environment.
